messages.subject: Invalid uid
messages.body_plain:
Every time I use the devtools::build() command, I get the following warning messages about invalid uid and gid:

> build()
'/usr/lib64/R/bin/R' --vanilla CMD build '/home/data1/share/sy/bouchard/bouchard'  \
  --no-manual --no-resave-data

* checking for file ‘/home/data1/share/sy/bouchard/bouchard/DESCRIPTION’ ... OK
* preparing ‘bouchard’:
* checking DESCRIPTION meta-information ... OK
* checking for LF line-endings in source and make files
* checking for empty or unneeded directories
* looking to see if a ‘data/datalist’ file should be added
* building ‘bouchard_0.1.tar.gz’
Warning: invalid uid value replaced by that for user 'nobody'
Warning: invalid gid value replaced by that for user 'nobody'

[1] "/home/data1/share/sy/bouchard/bouchard_0.1.tar.gz"

Does this have anything to do with my DESCRIPTION file (shown below)?

Package: bouchard
Title: Analysis of Placenta and Cord Blood DNA methylation data
Version: 0.1
Authors@R: 'Sahir Bhatnagar <sahir.b...@mcgill.ca> [aut, cre]'
Description: The goal of this package is to report results of an epigenome-wide association study (EWAS)
    in cord blood and placenta DNA samples from newborns with or without exposure to gestational
    diabetes mellitus (GD) using the Illumina Human Methylation450 array.
Depends: R (>= 3.1.0)
License: GPL-2
LazyData: true
Imports:
    betareg,
    bit64,
    calibrate,
    data.table,
    doMC,
    FDb.InfiniumMethylation.hg19,
    foreach,
    ggplot2,
    magrittr,
    qqman,
    qvalue
Suggests: testthat

messages.subject: Embedding R
messages.body_plain:
Dear RStudio developer.
I want to ask some help from you. my team is in final project of my bachelor study in indonesia. we decided to develop an open source statiscal software especially for spatial analysis and use R as it's backend. we met a problem to emmbed R engine in our software just like what you guys did in RStudio. we have been tried to look into your available source code and we still don't know how you guys did it. hopes you can help me in our final research.

Regards,
Jodi Jhouranda Siregar
Statistical University, Indonesia
Faculty of Computational Statistic
www.stis.ac.id <http://www.stis.ac.id>
